synopsis: EN ISO 19014-1 is reported as an existing European adoption, alongside EN ISO 16001:2017 [f2210]. Separately, FprEN ISO 19014-1:2026 was still in the CEN approval process as of 1 October 2026, distinguishing the reported adoption from the pending 2026 version [f2211, f2317]. The skeptic’s review links FprEN ISO 19014-1 to Regulation 2023/1230 under standardisation request M/605 [f10538]. Its planned publication date is 22 November 2026; the supplied facts establish a plan, not completed publication [f10539].

relations.note: Both report CEN approval status; f2317 dates it to 1 October 2026.
Planned November publication adds a milestone to the October approval status.
The planned publication date adds timing to the pending approval process.
